summary: Hinshelwood came on for Ayari in the 2-0 defeat at Hull and was rated poorly; Gómez and Andrés were Brighton's best midfielders. Still a bench option.

claims.text: Came on for Ayari at Hull; rated 4.75 and 'could not replicate the energy' of the man he replaced.
